title: The Gear Maze
text: A hall of turning gears, each as tall as a house, their teeth grinding past each other with a sound like the world's slow chewing. Oil drips from above. The only way through is between them, and there are bones in the oil.

options.label: The sharpest times the turning gears.

outcomes.text: Through without a scratch, step by counted step.
Through, mostly, with oil and blood on your coats.
A sleeve caught, and the arm in it.

options.label: Jam the gears with a beam.

outcomes.text: They grind to a halt with a shriek, and the whole ruin shudders awake.
